item.title: Sinister Dexter return in Bulletopia - Out Now! | 2000 AD
item.description: In the rotting corpse of a city called Downlode, only the most ruthless people can survive. Finnigan Sinister and Ramone Dexter have made their mark working together as ‘gun-sharks’ (hitmen) for some of the underworld’s biggest mob bosses.

item.title: Out Now: Rex Power Brings Dino-MIGHT To Your Shelves! | 2000 AD
item.description: Crash-landing onto shelves next year, the adventures of dino-alien bounty hunter REX POWER bring all the excitement of this awesome all-ages comic series to your home in complete collected form!

item.title: Definitely (PJ) Maybe! Pre-order Judge Dredd: The Complete Case Files 51!
item.description: PJ Maybe - Mega-City One's most elusive serial killer - returns in a bid to seize power in the Big Meg while murdering as many people as possible. If he can break himself out of prison, he'll be free to let chaos reign once more as the series that collects The Law in order reaches the epic storyline - Day of Chaos. Only one man stands in the path of the hell that is to be unleashed - Judge Dredd.

item.title: Dan Abnett & INJ Culbard on the sci-fi comic you SHOULD be reading! — In Orbit Every Wednesday
item.description: Molch-R & KLO-E welcome writer Dan Abnett and artist INJ Culbard onto In Orbit Every Wednesday to talk about the new series of Brink in 2000 AD, from the challenges and opportunities of long-form storytelling, creative collaboration, and whether the series has a definite end in sight… Catch up on Brink: Hosted by 2000 AD […]

item.title: 2000 AD Covers Uncovered: Steve Yeowell Gives The Discarded a Static Shock for Prog 2474! | 2000 AD
item.description: Borag Thungg, Earthlets. Welcome to Covers Uncovered, where we welcome veteran art droid Steve Yeowell to the front cover of Prog 2474, bringing his perfect take on the chaos happening down on Junkfall in Peter Milligan and Kieran McKeown’s The Departed, hitting its penultimate part this Prog.

item.title: Eat The Rich! — In Orbit Every Wednesday
item.description: Revolution, rebellion, and moral comeuppance — there’s a theme running through a lot of the stories in the latest issues of 2000 AD and the Judge Dredd Megazine, and it ain’t exactly pro-billionaire! Molch-R and KLO-E run through the gamut of stories in this week’s new issues to discuss the morality of wealth, the joy […]

item.title: 2000 AD Prog 2474 Is Out Now!
item.description: Call me The Mighty Tharg, the all-powerful alien editor at the helm of this SF anthology!

item.title: OUT NOW: Judge Dredd Megazine #490 | 2000 AD
item.description: Welcome back to the mighty Megazine, inside of which you'll find the last instalments of both current Judge Dredd thriller Halfway House (though not the last we’ll be seeing of Joe Fargo, who’ll be playing a prominent role in this year’s mega-epic The Oubliette, which will be running across both 2000 AD and the Meg in the summer) and Armitage: Drokk the Ripper.

item.title: The Weekly 2000 AD Lands in ASDA!
item.description: Brace yourselves, readers: starting with next week’s 2000 AD Prog 2475, The Galaxy’s Greatest Comic will now be available to pick up each and every week at ASDA! The news means ASDA joins major supermarkets across the UK including Morrisons, Sainsbury’s, Tesco, Co-Op and many more in stocking 2000 AD in their magazine section – […]

item.title: Rebellion's Lunar Listings for June 2026 | 2000 AD
item.description: Rebellion Publishing are now available through Lunar Distribution, which means your local comics retailer will be able to order titles direct from the Lunar Catalogue on your behalf! And that now includes the weekly 2000 AD, meaning readers in the USA can pick up new copies of The Galaxy's Greatest Comic every single week - don't forget to pre-order your Thrills from your local merchant!
